pkgmetadata.longdescription: llama.cpp provides local LLM inference. HadalOS packages it for the Vulkan compute backend specifically: it is the model runtime behind hadald's local tier, and Vulkan is the one compute path that works on both halves of the reference hardware (RDNA4 and Iris Xe) with no vendor userspace. Not in ::gentoo, which carries only the standalone sci-ml/ggml tensor library and sci-ml/ollama.

use.flag: Build the ggml Vulkan compute backend. This is the reason the package exists; disabling it leaves a CPU-only build.
Build sci-ml/llama-cpp's HTTP server, which exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. This is what hadald talks to over loopback. Implies tools.
Build the command-line tools, including llama-bench and llama-quantize.

Link against sci-ml/ggml instead of the vendored copy. Pinned to the exact vendored version because upstream's find_package(ggml) carries no version check, so a mismatch fails as a link error rather than a refusal.
Use OpenMP for CPU threading in the vendored ggml.
